mapper.select: SELECT r.reta_batch_id AS retaBatchId, r.batch_no AS batchNo, r.trace_code AS traceCode, r.product_code AS productCode, r.breed AS breed, r.product_type AS productType, r.product_form AS productForm, r.spec_grade AS specGrade, r.price AS price, r.image_url AS imageUrl, r.quality_status AS qualityStatus, r.status AS status, r.trace_time AS traceTime, rn.name AS retailerName, rn.address AS retailerAddress, rn.telephone AS retailerTelephone, z.batch_no AS frozBatchNo, zn.name AS processorName, f.batch_no AS farmBatchNo, f.source_type AS sourceType, fn.name AS farmName, p.prov_name AS originProvince FROM reta_batch r LEFT JOIN node_info rn ON rn.node_id = r.node_id LEFT JOIN whol_batch w ON w.batch_no = r.up_batch_no LEFT JOIN froz_batch z ON z.batch_no = w.up_batch_no LEFT JOIN node_info zn ON zn.node_id = z.node_id LEFT JOIN farm_batch f ON f.batch_no = z.up_batch_no LEFT JOIN node_info fn ON fn.node_id = f.node_id LEFT JOIN province p ON p.prov_id = fn.prov_id WHERE r.reta_batch_id = #{retaBatchId}

SELECT COALESCE(r.product_form, '未标注') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM reta_batch r WHERE r.status = 3 AND r.trace_code IS NOT NULL AND (r.quality_status IS NULL OR r.quality_status <> 2) GROUP BY COALESCE(r.product_form, '未标注') ORDER BY value DESC
